relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, i.t. or i.p. treatment with EGCG raised the IGF-1+ ratio in Iba-1+ cells

relationships.subject: EGCG
relationships.evidence_quote: i.t. EGCG treatment prevented microglia polarization (reduced iNOS+ microglia) and maintained IGF-1+ microglia (putative resting microglia) in diabetic mice

relationships.subject: IGF-1
relationships.evidence_quote: treatment with rIGF-1 attenuated the increase in the spinal protein expression of iNOS, IL-1β, and TNF-α

relationships.subject: EGCG
relationships.evidence_quote: i.t. or i.p. treatment with EGCG blocked the elevation in the spinal protein expression of iNOS, IL-1β, and TNF-α

relationships.subject: IGF-1
relationships.evidence_quote: the increased CGRP immunoreactivity in the SDH of T1DM mice was reduced by the i.t. injection of rIGF-1 on D14

relationships.subject: EGCG
relationships.evidence_quote: the intensified CGRP immunoreactivity in the SDH of T1DM mice was decreased by either i.t. or i.p. treatment with EGCG

key_findings: Spinal microglial IGF-1 signaling fell in STZ diabetic mice alongside M1 polarization, IL-1β and TNF-α rise and pain behaviors.
rIGF-1 and EGCG restored microglial IGF-1, reduced neuroinflammation and alleviated pain-like behaviors.
